summary: mypy rejects its own test package because it cannot infer the generic type argument of retry_on_error.
root_cause: retry_on_error promises to return the callback's generic result, but callers use side-effect-only lambdas whose return contract provides no useful type argument. The helper signature is over-general for its use.
recommended_action: Give retry_on_error a side-effect callback contract such as Callable[[], Any] returning None, consistent with the call sites.
